已提交补丁 `patch_e6eca3851a4d896b37f16cb5`，候选编译通过（verificationStatus=passed，0 错误 0 警告）。

**修改内容**（results.tex 第一段，仅一处）：

- 前：`In this study, we report that accuracy is 91.2\% on 12 samples.`
- 后：`Accuracy is 91.2\% on 12 samples.`

保留了 `91.2\%`、`12 samples`、否定结论 `We do not claim statistical significance` 及 citation `\cite{smith2024}`，未新增任何事实。请在预览中 Accept 后生效。

patch.title: Trim opening phrase in results.tex first paragraph so it starts with capitalized \"Accuracy\", keeping numbers, negative conclusion, and citation unchanged.
